title: security-compliance-review-prep-1on1-maria-gomez-2026-03-04
body:
Quick prep notes for 1:1 with Alex (security reviewer) - focus on SOC2 readiness + vendor attestations. Draft for my notes; will tidy after the call.

Goal: align on outstanding evidence for the upcoming external SOC2 readiness check (mid-Apr audit), confirm vendor attestation gaps, and get clarity on which controls we should prioritize for next sprint. Also want to validate the auditor questions list and agree owners/timelines.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick status (2 min) - what auditor already has / what they asked for last week
2) SOC2 evidence gaps mapped to owners (10 min) - focus Security & Availability controls
3) Vendor risk / third-party attestation plan (8 min) - who to chase, what to accept as compensating control
4) Audit readiness timeline and sprint alignment (5 min)
5) Immediate action items & blockers (5 min)

Notes / context:
- Auditor asked for access review evidence for production clusters (last 6 months). We ran a partial review in Jan but need exports for Feb and Mar (SRE + IAM).
- Control mapping: Security (logical access, IAM), Change Management (PR approvals & deployment logs), Monitoring & Alerting (pager incidents & SLAs), Encryption in transit at service boundaries.
- ISO overlap: inventory of assets (A.8), vendor inventory + contracts (A.15), and incident response playbook (A.16) - useful to include as crosswalk artifacts.
- Vendors: Primary concerns = monitoring provider (LogStream), third-party telemetry (MetricHub), and auth vendor (Authly). Need current SOC2/ISO attestation or recent penetration test reports. Some vendors only provide self-attestations.

Evidence checklist (what auditor explicitly requested / what I need to gather):
- Access review exports (prod clusters) - Feb & Mar CSVs (owner: Aaron Lee; jira TKT-1234)
- RBAC matrix (updated) + last approval signatures (owner: Priya Desai)
- Deploy approvals + change tickets for last 6 months (owner: Ryan Kim)
- Monitoring alert runbooks and incident postmortems (owner: Maya Thompson)
- Vendor attestation PDFs for LogStream, MetricHub, Authly (owner: Maria Gomez)
- Encryption config docs (TLS cert rotation schedule) (owner: Infra Eng)

Questions for Alex / auditor to clarify:
- Is a vendor self-attestation acceptable if we have compensating controls (e.g., additional monitoring + contract clauses)?
- Minimum level of artifact for access reviews (export vs. signed summary)? Auditor mentioned a CSV is fine but wants evidence of authorization to run the export - need to confirm format.
- For backlog of minor exceptions, can we aggregate in a single risk register entry or do they require per-issue remediation evidence?

Risks / blockers I want to raise in the 1:1:
- SRE bandwidth to run full access review exports before the close-of-business next week (they are on-call rotation)
- Some vendors (Authly) delayed in sharing SOC2; procurement says they have a contract clause but no attestation. This may delay sign-off.
- PR history for older services not kept in single repo (some repos archived) - change mgmt evidence might be fragmented.

Immediate action items (post call) - short, owner, target date:
1) Aaron Lee: export prod access review CSVs (Feb & Mar) and upload to Confluence page; target: 2026-03-08
2) Priya Desai: finalize RBAC matrix + attach approval emails; target: 2026-03-07
3) Ryan Kim: collate deployment tickets for last 6 months (zip export) and link in Jira SEC-412; target: 2026-03-09
4) Maria Gomez (me): chase LogStream & MetricHub attestation PDFs, escalate to procurement if no response by 2026-03-06
5) Maya Thompson: export incident postmortems for last 6 months and highlight any SLA breaches; target: 2026-03-10
6) Aaron + Infra Eng: produce TLS rotation schedule doc snippet for auditor (where stored, last rotation date); target: 2026-03-08

Notes-to-self / follow-ups:
- Add a crosswalk doc mapping SOC2 criteria to our existing Confluence artifacts (quick start template exists at linked_artifacts). Prioritize Security and Change Management controls.
- Prepare a short one-pager for leadership listing residual vendor risks and mitigation plan (to be shared with legal/procurement).
- If auditor accepts aggregated risk register entries, create standardized template.

Possible quick wins to reduce audit friction:
- Create a simple export script for access reviews (SRE + IAM) to avoid manual CSV pulls each month.
- Create a single Confluence folder with named artifacts (RBAC, access exports, deployment zip, vendor attestations) and share link with auditor.

Backchannel items to discuss with Priya after 1:1: whether we can accept signed email approvals as evidence for RBAC changes (some teams don't use Jira approvals).

Draft email to auditor after call (short):
- Subject: Follow-up artifacts for SOC2 readiness check
- Body: Thanks for the 1:1 today. Per our conversation, attaching access review exports (Feb/Mar), RBAC matrix, deployment ticket bundle, incident postmortems, and vendor attestation PDFs (as received). Please confirm if CSV export format is acceptable for access review and whether aggregated risk register entries meet evidence requirements.

Tagging this doc as working scratchpad - will update after 1:1 and convert into shared Confluence checklist once owners confirm timelines.

End of notes.
